train-bpe.code:
# Train a real BPE tokenizer with Hugging Face `tokenizers` on the low/lower/newest/widest corpus,
# then encode words it has never seen.
from tokenizers import Tokenizer, models, pre_tokenizers, trainers

corpus = ["low"] * 5 + ["lower"] * 2 + ["newest"] * 6 + ["widest"] * 3
tok = Tokenizer(models.BPE(end_of_word_suffix="</w>"))
tok.pre_tokenizer = pre_tokenizers.Whitespace()
trainer = trainers.BpeTrainer(vocab_size=21, end_of_word_suffix="</w>", show_progress=False)
tok.train_from_iterator(corpus, trainer)

print("vocabulary size:", tok.get_vocab_size())
merges = tok.to_str()  # the trained model, as JSON
import json
print("first merges:", json.loads(merges)["model"]["merges"][:10])
for word in ["lowest", "newer", "slowly", "newest"]:
    print(f"{word:<8} → {tok.encode(word).tokens}")

compare-tokenizers.code:
# The same text through three real tokenizers: GPT-2 (byte-level BPE), BERT (WordPiece) and T5 (Unigram).
from transformers import AutoTokenizer

texts = ["unaffable", "Tokenization of HuggingFace", "The river bank flooded."]
for name in ["openai-community/gpt2", "google-bert/bert-base-uncased", "google-t5/t5-small"]:
    tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(name)
    print(f"== {name} (vocabulary {tok.vocab_size:,})")
    for t in texts:
        print(f"  {t!r:<32} {tok.tokenize(t)}")

sentence-search.code:
# Semantic search with the full-precision all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (the page runs a quantized copy in the browser).
from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer

docs = [
    "How do I reset my password?", "I forgot my login details", "My card was charged twice",
    "I see a payment I don't recognise", "How do I send money abroad?", "What is the interest rate on my mortgage?",
    "How do I order a new debit card?", "Can I increase my credit card limit?", "Where can I find my account number?",
    "How do I close my savings account?", "What are your branch opening hours?", "How do I set up a direct debit?",
]
queries = ["I can't sign in to my account", "transfer funds to another country", "I was billed two times for one purchase"]

model = SentenceTransformer("sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2")
D = model.encode(docs, normalize_embeddings=True)
Q = model.encode(queries, normalize_embeddings=True)
print("vector size:", D.shape[1])
for q, scores in zip(queries, Q @ D.T):
    best = scores.argsort()[::-1][:2]
    print(q, "→", [(docs[i], round(float(scores[i]), 3)) for i in best])
